CREATE TABLE pc_work_lanes (
	lane_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	head_sequence BIGINT, 
	next_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (lane_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_lanes_head_positive CHECK (head_sequence IS NULL OR head_sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_lanes_next_positive CHECK (next_sequence > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_work_items (
	work_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	logical_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	lane_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	lane_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	payload_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	available_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(128), 
	lease_fence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation_attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recovery_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	result_code VARCHAR(128), 
	result_payload BLOB, 
	error_category VARCHAR(64), 
	error_code VARCHAR(128), 
	state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (work_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_work_items_lane_sequence UNIQUE (lane_key, lane_sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_status CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'cancelling', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_lane_sequence_positive CHECK (lane_sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_payload_version_positive CHECK (payload_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_fence_nonnegative CHECK (lease_fence >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_attempts_nonnegative CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_generation_attempts_nonnegative CHECK (generation_attempt_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_recovery_nonnegative CHECK (recovery_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_max_attempts_positive CHECK (max_attempts > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_items_state_version_positive CHECK (state_version > 0)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_work_items_claim ON pc_work_items (status, available_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_work_items_lane_status ON pc_work_items (lane_key, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_work_items_scope_created ON pc_work_items (scope_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE pc_work_keys (
	logical_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	work_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	lane_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (logical_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_work_keys_work_id UNIQUE (work_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_work_attempts (
	work_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recovery_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	fence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	outcome VARCHAR(32), 
	error_category VARCHAR(64), 
	error_code VARCHAR(128), 
	trace_id VARCHAR(32), 
	span_id VARCHAR(16), 
	PRIMARY KEY (work_id, attempt_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_attempts_attempt_positive CHECK (attempt_no > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_attempts_recovery_nonnegative CHECK (recovery_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_work_attempts_fence_positive CHECK (fence > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_scheduler_leases (
	lease_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(128), 
	fence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (lease_name), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_scheduler_leases_fence_nonnegative CHECK (fence >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_scheduler_scans (
	discoverer VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	next_run_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	continuation VARCHAR(256), 
	state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (discoverer), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_scheduler_scans_version_positive CHECK (state_version > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_runtime_members (
	member_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	build_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	schema_min INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_max INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_min INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload_max INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	behavior_revision VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (member_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_runtime_members_role CHECK (role IN ('all', 'api', 'scheduler', 'worker')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_runtime_members_schema_range CHECK (schema_min > 0 AND schema_max >= schema_min), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_runtime_members_payload_range CHECK (payload_min > 0 AND payload_max >= payload_min)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_runtime_members_role_expiry ON pc_runtime_members (role, expires_at)

CREATE TABLE pc_rate_limit_windows (
	principal_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	request_count BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (principal_key, policy_id, window_started_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_rate_limit_windows_count_positive CHECK (request_count > 0)
)
